items.title: Genie 4 is now available
items.excerpt: Google DeepMind rolls out a new Project Genie experience with its Genie 4 world model to eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers, adding real-time prompt edits inside a generated world, chainable worlds and a community gallery for remixing; a day later Genie 4 also opened on the Gemini API for 720p interactive worlds with native audio. Follow-up to the 10-28 Genie 4 model debut (games).

items.title: Canva adds an AI 'off' button
items.excerpt: Canva is rolling out settings that let users and teams switch off most of its generative AI features and filter AI-made images, saying AI does not suit every task; some AI tools stay on.

items.title: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
items.excerpt: NVIDIA shows developers pairing frontier AI coding agents with Omniverse libraries to build simulation applications, test physical behavior and iterate on designs from a prompt.

items.title: Build Training-Ready Physical AI Datasets with Two Prompts in NVIDIA Cosmos
items.excerpt: NVIDIA details a Cosmos workflow that generates diverse, training-ready synthetic scenes (rare defects, nighttime incidents) from two prompts for physical AI and world-model training.

items.title: Introducing Vercel Board
items.excerpt: Vercel Board is an experimental shared message board where coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex coordinate tasks, exchange context and work together across tools.

items.title: Artists and creators are leaving Etsy in droves over its new AI policy
items.excerpt: Artists and makers are posting goodbye messages and leaving Etsy over its new AI policy. Follow-up to Etsy AI-policy stories covered 10-24/10-28.

items.title: AI Sped Up The Build: How Can Accessibility Testing Keep Up?
items.excerpt: AI has sped up how teams design and build but QA testing has not kept pace and the web may be getting less accessible; Andrew Chung draws on new research to explain what separates teams that keep accessibility quality up.

items.title: A turning point for CAD?
items.excerpt: DEVELOP3D comment: AI is reshaping CAD, promising smarter tools for designers while exposing the industry's resistance to rapid change. (Opinion piece.)

items.title: Pliera: a new BIM 2.0
items.excerpt: Pliera combines BIM modelling, AI-generated parametric objects and building configurators, with ambitious plans to challenge Revit.

items.title: Mitsubishi Electric CNC work cell uses AI and humanoid robots
items.excerpt: Shown at JIMTOF in Tokyo, Mitsubishi Electric's work cell combines AI, a CNC machine equipped with physical AI and a general-purpose humanoid robot.

items.title: Introducing the New Autodesk Fusion Plans: Simpler Access to Capabilities and More AI
items.excerpt: From January 28, 2027 Fusion moves to four plans (Starter, Standard, Professional, Enterprise) with AI capacity included in every plan and more AI at higher tiers; extensions are folded into the plans. (Pricing/packaging story; fetched via r.jina.ai, autodesk.com 403s curl.)

items.title: Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you
items.excerpt: Gemini's Mac app gets computer use for AI Plus, Pro and Ultra users: an agent that can organize files, fill out forms and run multistep workflows across desktop apps.

items.title: What Your AGENTS.md Should Say About Your Design System
items.excerpt: Supernova checked 30 design-system repos for AGENTS.md and other agent files: 16 have one, none is written for teams consuming the system; it proposes a section to copy.

items.title: Figma Variables vs Design Tokens in 2026
items.excerpt: How Figma variables differ from design tokens in 2026: what each stores, how the six variable types map to DTCG 2025.10 types, and what each gives an AI agent.

items.title: From idea to decision: what we're learning about AI in engineering
items.excerpt: nTop shares what it is learning about using AI across the engineering design workflow, from early ideas to design decisions. (Vendor blog; date-only publish stamp.)

items.title: How to Generate AI Videos in Claude With the Higgsfield MCP Connector (2026)
items.excerpt: Higgsfield guide to generating video, images, audio and ads from inside Claude via its MCP connector: setup, first video, credits and fixes. (Vendor how-to.)

items.title: Krea Originals 01 & 02: ROCKET and RECESS
items.excerpt: Krea's first two original short films, made on one Nodes canvas with Krea 2 Turbo for characters and locations, Seedance 2.5 for every scene and prompts written in Claude; the post breaks down the pipeline. Check movies for cross-section dup.

items.title: Too Claudified
items.excerpt: A designer whose AI-built motion graphics were rejected by a client as 'too Claudified' revisits his June essay on AI design converging on one fluent look, and what changed in five months.

items.title: AI Prototype to Production: 7 Steps to Working UI
items.excerpt: Design agency Eleken lays out a seven-step workflow for taking AI-generated prototypes to production-ready UI, pitched as roughly 2x faster delivery. (Agency blog.)

items.title: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol with lower API prices and some benchmark gains
items.excerpt: GPT-6.2 Astra pulls slide layouts, colors and typography from templates, built and animated 3D models in Blender in demos, and tops the AA-3D web-design benchmark (1,318 Elo vs Claude Fable 5.2 at 1,271); Astra API price cut 20%.
